issues.title: Kin of Peru state violence victims reject Fujimori's right to rule
issues.summary: LIMA, Peru — Relatives of people who died at the hands of the Peruvian state over the years on Tuesday spurned president-elect Keiko Fujimori and her legitimacy to govern, citing the risk of democratic backsliding and judicial impunity.
